desc.en: Go to the other half of the bracket pair under the cursor.
Select inside an object or a pair: a word, a sentence, a clause, the nearest pair, brackets, quotes. The next key says which.
Select around it: the pair or the marks come along.
Surround the selection with a pair. Under vim, after a motion: ysiw( wraps the word.
Delete the pair around the cursor.
Replace the pair around the cursor: first the one to replace, then the new one.
